messages:
Maria C.: Quick async check — need final owner list for the v2 bridge/compat rollout. Where are we on SDK patch, proxy shim, and docs? Milestone: cutover window planned 2026-06-10. Confirming blockers.

David K.: SDK status: PR #482 is in review, tests flaky because of a new header validation. I can own merging once CI is green. ETA: EOD tomorrow unless @Chris P. finds more in E2E.

Lee (oncall): Proxy shim: infra flagged a token-propagation edge case on streaming connections. Filed infra#1234 with logs. Hotfix ready but needs an infra approval for canary. I can schedule the canary for Thu morning if we want.

Anya R.: Docs/migration guide: I'm preparing the v2 migration notes and examples. Two open Qs: (1) function-calling example differences, (2) expected behavior when we fallback and return 429s. @David K. can you confirm runtime semantics for 429 vs circuit-breaker?

Chris P.: E2E smoke failing in staging (job: v2-smoke). Repro: headers mismatch on the platform proxy. Quick curl:```curl -i -H 'x-api-version: v2' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' https://staging.redwood/api/ping``` returns 400 with body `InvalidRouteError: header x-client-mode missing`. Bisecting now.

Maria C.: Thanks. @Chris P. paste the minimal failing log snippet here so we can triage. If it's SDK removing a header we need to coordinate pause for canary.

Chris P.: Minimal log: ```ERROR [proxy] 2026-06-02T14:22:01Z InvalidRouteError: header x-client-mode missing at ProxyRouter.handle (/svc/proxy/router.js:142)``` Looks like SDK change in #480 removed the default `x-client-mode` header. Rolling back in staging reproduces green.

David K.: Confirmed — #480 removed the default header because the backend was validating it incorrectly. I can add an opt-in flag to remove it, but for the rollout we should preserve the header. I'll push a fix (add compatibility flag `X_CLIENT_LEGACY=1`) in the next hour.

Lee (oncall): If we preserve the header, we should emit a deprecation warning in responses (infra prefers gradual deprecation with visible warnings). I'll add a canary check that looks for the header and the warning text.

Maria C.: Ownership recap: SDK = David K., Proxy shim/canary = Lee (oncall), Docs/migration guide = Anya R., E2E smoke and staging validation = Chris P. I'll update the rollout spreadsheet and notify infra. Everyone please ack below.

David K.: ack — will push fix + test by +1h. :thumbsup:

Lee (oncall): ack — canary slot tentative Thu 03:00 UTC, ping infra for approval.

Anya R.: ack — I'll add the deprecation note and a short migration snippet for the header change.

Chris P.: ack — will re-run v2-smoke after David's patch. I have a quick harness to assert header presence.

deploy-bot: Canary window available: 2026-06-08 03:00 UTC (us-west). Please confirm approvals at least 24h before.

Maria C.: Great — I'll follow up with a short standup note tomorrow. If any of you hit blockers that block the canary (tests red, infra deny), escalate here and @oncall. Otherwise we'll proceed with the tentative schedule. Thanks!
